questions.question_nepali: CPU का आन्तरिक रजिस्टरहरू (PC, MAR, MBR, IR, AC, PSW) को भूमिका र विशेषताहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the role and characteristics of CPU Internal Registers: PC, MAR, MBR, IR, Accumulator, and Program Status Word (PSW).
questions.answer_nepali:
१. आन्तरिक रजिस्टरको भूमिका: प्रोसेसरभित्र रहेका उच्च गतिको अस्थायी भण्डारण एकाइहरू।
२. प्रमुख रजिस्टरहरू:
• PC: अर्को पढिने निर्देशनको ठेगाना राख्छ।
• MAR: पढ्न वा लेख्न लागिएको मेमोरी ठेगाना राख्छ।
• MBR: मेमोरीबाट आएको वा जान लागेको वास्तविक डाटा राख्छ।
• IR: हाल प्रोसेस भइरहेको निर्देशन राख्छ।
• AC (Accumulator): गणितीय हिसाबको नतिजा अस्थायी रूपमा राख्छ।
• PSW: हिसाबको नतिजाका फ्ल्यागहरू (Zero, Carry, Sign) राख्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Internal Registers: High-speed temporary storage cells situated inside CPU silicon operating at clock frequency.
2. Roles:
• Program Counter (PC): Holds memory address of next instruction to be fetched.
• Memory Address Register (MAR): Holds address in memory currently being read from or written to.
• Memory Buffer Register (MBR): Holds data read from or waiting to be written to memory.
• Instruction Register (IR): Holds the operational opcode currently being decoded.
• Accumulator (AC): Temporary register storing operands and immediate results of ALU arithmetic.
• Program Status Word (PSW): Holds status condition flags (Zero Flag, Carry Flag, Sign Flag, Overflow Flag, Interrupt Enable).

questions.unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, CPU Registers, Memory & DMA
questions.question_nepali: Superscalar CPU आर्किटेक्चर के हो? Scalar र Superscalar प्रोसेसर बीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: What is Superscalar CPU architecture? Contrast Scalar and Superscalar processors with respect to Instruction Level Parallelism (ILP).
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Superscalar को अवधारणा: एउटै घडीको साइकलमा दुई वा बढी निर्देशनहरू एकै पटक कार्यान्वयन गर्न सक्ने आधुनिक प्रोसेसर आर्किटेक्चर।
२. तुलना:
• Scalar: एक साइकलमा अधिकतम एउटा मात्र निर्देशन कार्यान्वयन गर्छ।
• Superscalar: एक साइकलमा धेरै वटा निर्देशनहरू समानान्तर रूपमा चलाउँछ (Multiple Execution Units)।
३. प्रयोग: बैंकका आधुनिक सर्भरहरूमा अत्यधिक प्रयोग हुने प्रविधि।
questions.answer_english:
1. Superscalar Concept: A CPU architecture that implements Instruction Level Parallelism (ILP) by fetching, decoding, and dispatching multiple instructions concurrently per clock cycle to multiple redundant execution units (ALUs, FPUs).
2. Comparison:
• Scalar Processor: Executes at most one instruction per clock cycle (`CPI >= 1`). Pipelined, but single execution datapath.
• Superscalar Processor: Can execute multiple instructions per cycle (`IPC > 1`). Employs dynamic out-of-order execution, branch prediction, and multi-issue dispatch units.
3. Modern Application: Standard architecture in multi-core banking server CPUs (Intel Xeon, AMD EPYC, ARM Neoverse).

questions.question_nepali: Locality of Reference (Temporal र Spatial Locality) को सिद्धान्त व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। यसले क्यास मेमोरीको उपयोगितालाई कसरी पुष्टि गर्दछ?
questions.question_english: Explain the principle of Locality of Reference (Temporal Locality and Spatial Locality). How does it justify the effectiveness of Cache Memory?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Locality of Reference को अवधारणा: कम्प्युटर प्रोग्राम चल्दा छोटो समयभित्र सीमित मेमोरी क्षेत्रमा पटकपटक पहुँच गर्ने प्रवृत्तिको सिद्धान्त।
२. प्रकारहरू:
• Temporal Locality: भर्खरै प्रयोग भएको डाटा निकट भविष्यमा फेरि प्रयोग हुने सम्भावना (जस्तै: लूप रिएबल)।
• Spatial Locality: कुनै डाटा प्रयोग भएपछि त्यसको नजिकै रहेको डाटा पनि छिट्टै प्रयोग हुने सम्भावना (जस्तै: एरे र क्रमिक निर्देशनहरू)।
३. क्यासको उपयोगिता: यसै सिद्धान्तका कारण सानो क्यास मेमोरी राख्दा पनि ९५% भन्दा बढी डाटा क्यासबाटै तुरुन्त प्राप्त हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Locality of Reference: Empirical observation that executing programs access a relatively small portion of their address space at any given time.
2. Dimensions:
• Temporal Locality (Locality in Time): If a memory location is referenced once, it is highly likely to be referenced again in the near future (e.g., loop variables, subroutine calls, transaction state variables). Cache retains recently referenced blocks.
• Spatial Locality (Locality in Space): If a memory location is referenced, nearby memory locations are likely to be referenced soon (e.g., sequential instruction execution, array traversals). Cache fetches entire blocks/lines rather than single bytes.
3. Cache Justification: Allows small, fast SRAM caches (1-3% of RAM capacity) to service 95%+ of memory requests.

questions.unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, CPU Registers, Memory & DMA
questions.question_nepali: कम्प्युटर आर्किटेक्चरमा Bus Arbitration व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Centralized र Distributed Arbitration बीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Bus Arbitration in computer architecture. Compare Centralized Arbitration (Daisy Chaining, Polling) with Distributed Arbitration.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Bus Arbitration को अवधारणा: जब एकभन्दा बढी उपकरणहरूले एकै पटक साझा कम्प्युटर बस प्रयोग गर्न खोज्छन्, कसलाई पहिले प्रयोग गर्न दिने भनी निर्णय गर्ने विधि।
२. विधिहरू:
• Daisy Chaining: सिरियल तारमार्फत पालैपालो अनुमति दिने। नजिकको उपकरणले बढी प्राथमिकता पाउँछ।
• Polling: कन्ट्रोलरले पालैपालो सबै डिभाइसलाई सोध्ने।
• Distributed: कुनै केन्द्रीय कन्ट्रोलर बिना सबै डिभाइसहरूले आपसमा मिलेर प्राथमिकता निर्धारण गर्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Bus Arbitration: The mechanism by which multiple bus masters (CPU cores, DMA controllers) coordinate ownership of shared system address and data buses.
2. Schemes:
• Daisy Chaining (Centralized): Bus Grant signal propagates serially through all master devices. Highest priority closest to arbiter; lowest priority prone to starvation.
• Polling (Centralized): Bus controller steps through master device IDs on polling lines. Flexible priority sequencing.
• Independent Request (Centralized): Each master has dedicated Bus Request and Bus Grant lines to arbiter. Fast, but higher pin count.
• Distributed Arbitration: Devices determine priority collaboratively using unique priority codes on shared lines without single point of failure.

questions.unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, OSI Model, Subnetting & Cryptography
questions.question_nepali: Network Address Translation (NAT) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्: Static, Dynamic र PAT। PAT ले पब्लिक IPv4 ठेगाना कसरी बचत गर्छ?
questions.question_english: Explain Network Address Translation (NAT): Static NAT, Dynamic NAT, and Port Address Translation (PAT). How does PAT conserve public IPv4 addresses?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. NAT को अवधारणा: बैंकको आन्तरिक निजी (Private) IP लाई इन्टरनेटमा चल्ने सार्वजनिक (Public) IP मा बदल्ने प्रविधि।
२. प्रकारहरू:
• Static NAT: एउटा प्राइभेट IP का लागि एउटा स्थायी पब्लिक IP।
• Dynamic NAT: उपलब्ध पब्लिक IP को समूहबाट पालैपालो बाँड्ने।
• Port Address Translation (PAT): एउटै पब्लिक IP र फरक-फरक पोर्ट नम्बर प्रयोग गरेर सयौं कम्प्युटरहरूलाई इन्टरनेट चलाउन दिने। यसले सीमित IPv4 ठेगानाको अत्यधिक बचत गर्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. NAT Concept: Modifies network address information in IP packet headers while in transit across an edge router.
2. Types:
• Static NAT: One-to-one permanent mapping of an internal private IP to a designated public IP. Used for public-facing bank servers.
• Dynamic NAT: Maps private IPs to a pool of available public IPs on first-come, first-served basis.
• Port Address Translation (PAT / NAT Overload): Maps thousands of internal private IP addresses to a SINGLE public IP address by tracking unique Layer 4 source port numbers.
3. Conservation: Allows an entire commercial bank branch with 500+ workstations to share a single public IPv4 address simultaneously.

questions.unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, OSI Model, Subnetting & Cryptography
questions.question_nepali: डाटा कम्युनिकेसनमा Error Detection र Correction प्रविधिहरू (Parity, Checksum, CRC) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Error Detection and Correction techniques in data communication: Parity Check, Checksum, and Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC).
questions.answer_nepali:
१. एरर कन्ट्रोलको अवधारणा: तार वा नेटवर्कबाट डाटा पठाउँदा बाटोमा डाटा बिग्रियो कि बिग्रिएन भनी पत्ता लगाउने प्रविधि।
२. प्रविधिहरू:
• Parity Check: अन्त्यमा १ बिट थपेर जोड वा विजोर संख्या मिलाउने। सरल तर १ बिट गल्ती मात्र पत्ता लगाउँछ।
• Checksum: संख्याहरूको जोड निकालेर अन्त्यमा पठाउने (TCP/IP मा प्रयोग हुने)।
• Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC): गणितीय बहुपदीय भाग (Polynomial Division) विधि। अत्यन्त शक्तिशाली र नेटवर्कमा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Error Control: Mechanisms ensuring frames received across noisy communication links match transmitted payloads.
2. Techniques:
• Parity Check: Appends a single parity bit (even or odd parity). Detects only single-bit errors; fails completely on even-bit errors.
• Internet Checksum: 16-bit one's complement sum of header words used in IPv4 and TCP/UDP. Detects multi-bit errors, but weak against burst errors.
• Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC): Polynomial binary division (`CRC-32`). Generates a mathematical remainder appended to frame. Detects all single and double-bit errors, odd-number bit errors, and burst errors up to polynomial degree.

questions.unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, OSI Model, Subnetting & Cryptography
questions.question_nepali: Guided Transmission Media (Twisted Pair, Coaxial, Fiber Optic) को ब्यान्डविथ, अटेनुएसन र सुरक्षाका आधारमा तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Guided Transmission Media (Twisted Pair, Coaxial, Fiber Optic) in bandwidth, attenuation, EMI immunity, and banking deployment.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. गाइडेड मिडिया: तारको माध्यमबाट डाटा पठाउने भौतिक माध्यम।
२. तुलना:
• Twisted Pair (Cat6): तामाको तार बटारेर बनाइएको। सस्तो र १०० मिटरसम्म १० Gbps गति दिने। कार्यालयभित्र कम्प्युटर जोड्न मानक।
• Coaxial: बीचमा तामा र वरिपरि जाली भएको तार।
• Fiber Optic: सिसाको मसिनो रेसाबाट प्रकाशको गतिमा डाटा पठाउने। अत्यन्त उच्च गति (Terabits), ४० किलोमिटरसम्म जान सक्ने, र बाह्य विद्युतीय गडबडीबाट १००% सुरक्षित। बैंकको ब्याकबोन नेटवर्कमा प्रयोग हुने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Guided Media: Physical cabling conducting electromagnetic signals.
2. Comparison:
• Twisted Pair (Cat6/Cat6a): Copper wires twisted to cancel crosstalk. 1-10 Gbps up to 100 meters. Low cost, easy termination, moderate EMI susceptibility. Standard for desktop workstations.
• Coaxial Cable: Copper core with braided metallic shield. Good noise immunity, but bulky and legacy.
• Fiber Optic Cable (Single-Mode / Multi-Mode): Transmits light pulses through silica glass core. Gigabits/Terabits per second over 40+ km; ultra-low attenuation; 100% immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI) and wiretapping. Mandatory for inter-branch WAN and data center server backbones.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: अपरेटिङ सिस्टममा Monolithic Kernel, Microkernel र Hybrid Kernel आर्किटेक्चर बीच उदाहरण सहित तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Monolithic Kernel, Microkernel, and Hybrid Kernel architectures in operating system design with examples.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Monolithic Kernel: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सम्पूर्ण मुख्य सेवाहरू (ड्राइभर, फाइल सिस्टम, प्रोसेस म्यानेजर) एउटै कर्नेल स्पेसभित्र चल्छन्। यो छिटो हुन्छ तर एउटा ड्राइभरमा समस्या आउँदा पूरै प्रणाली क्र्यास हुन सक्छ (जस्तै: लिनक्स)।
२. Microkernel: केवल न्यूनतम आधारभूत कार्यहरू मात्र कर्नेलमा चल्छन्; ड्राइभर र फाइल सिस्टमहरू युजर स्पेसमा चल्छन्। यो अत्यन्त सुरक्षित र भरपर्दो हुन्छ तर कम्युनिकेसनमा समय बढी लाग्छ (जस्तै: QNX)।
३. Hybrid Kernel: दुवैको फाइदा लिएर बनाइएको कर्नेल, जहाँ गति र सुरक्षाको सन्तुलन हुन्छ (जस्तै: Windows NT)।
questions.answer_english:
1. Monolithic Kernel: All core OS services (VFS, device drivers, process scheduler, memory manager) run inside a single unified kernel address space in ring 0. High execution speed, but a bug in one driver can crash the entire system (e.g., Linux).
2. Microkernel: Only essential mechanisms (IPC, low-level scheduling, basic memory management) run in kernel space. Drivers and file systems run in user space. High modularity, resilience, and security, but higher IPC context-switching overhead (e.g., QNX, Minix).
3. Hybrid Kernel: Combines monolithic performance with microkernel modularity, running key subsystems in kernel space while maintaining modular driver layers (e.g., Windows NT, macOS XNU).

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: Process र Thread बीच भिन्नता छुट्याउनुहोस्। User-Level Threads (ULT) र Kernel-Level Threads (KLT) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Differentiate between Process and Thread. Explain User-Level Threads (ULT) and Kernel-Level Threads (KLT).
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Process र Thread: प्रोसेस भन्नाले आफ्नै निजी मेमोरी र स्रोत भएको स्वतन्त्र प्रोग्रामलाई बुझाउँछ। थ्रेड भन्नाले एउटै प्रोसेसभित्र रहने सानो कार्य एकाइ हो जसले प्रोसेसको साझा मेमोरी प्रयोग गर्दछ।
२. ULT र KLT:
• User-Level Threads: युजर स्पेसको लाइब्रेरीमार्फत व्यवस्थापन हुने, छिटो चल्ने तर एउटा थ्रेड रोकिँदा पूरै प्रोसेस रोकिन सक्ने।
• Kernel-Level Threads: सिधै अपरेटिङ सिस्टमको कर्नेलद्वारा व्यवस्थापन हुने, मल्टिकोर प्रोसेसरमा वास्तविक रूपमा समानान्तर चल्न सक्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Process vs Thread: A process is an independent program in execution with its own private address space, PCB, and system resources. A thread is a lightweight execution unit within a process sharing the same address space, code, and data sections, but maintaining its own stack, registers, and program counter.
2. ULT vs KLT:
• User-Level Threads (ULT): Managed by thread libraries in user space without kernel awareness. Fast context switching without system calls, but if one thread blocks on I/O, the entire process is blocked.
• Kernel-Level Threads (KLT): Managed directly by the OS kernel scheduler. True multi-core parallel execution; if one thread blocks, other threads continue running, though context switches incur kernel transitions.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: Inter-Process Communication (IPC) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Shared Memory र Message Passing संयन्त्रहरू बीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Inter-Process Communication (IPC). Compare Shared Memory and Message Passing mechanisms in operating systems.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. IPC को अवधारणा: अपरेटिङ सिस्टममा चलिरहेका विभिन्न प्रोसेसहरू बीच डाटा आदानप्रदान र समन्वय गर्ने विधिलाई IPC भनिन्छ।
२. तुलना:
• Shared Memory: दुई वा बढी प्रोसेसहरूले साझा मेमोरी प्रयोग गरेर डाटा साट्छन्। यो अत्यन्त छिटो हुन्छ तर रेस कन्डिसन रोक्न सेमाफोर आवश्यक पर्छ।
• Message Passing: कर्नेलको सहायताले सन्देश पठाएर (Send/Receive) कुराकानी गरिन्छ। यो अलि सुस्त भए पनि फरक-फरक कम्प्युटर बीच काम गर्न उपयुक्त हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. IPC Overview: Mechanisms enabling cooperating processes to exchange data, synchronize actions, and coordinate execution.
2. Comparison:
• Shared Memory: Processes map a common physical memory region into their virtual address spaces. Communication occurs at memory bus speeds with zero kernel intervention after initial setup. Requires explicit synchronization mechanisms (Semaphores, Mutex) to prevent race conditions.
• Message Passing: Processes communicate by exchanging explicit messages through kernel primitives (`send()` and `receive()`). Slower due to kernel context switches and buffer copying, but ideal for distributed or multi-server environments without shared memory.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: Critical Section समस्या के हो? यसको मान्य समाधानका लागि आवश्यक तीन सर्तहरू (Mutual Exclusion, Progress, Bounded Waiting) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: What is the Critical Section Problem? State the three requirements (Mutual Exclusion, Progress, Bounded Waiting) for a valid solution.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Critical Section को अवधारणा: प्रोग्रामको यस्तो भाग जहाँ साझा डाटा वा बैंकको खाता ब्यालेन्स जस्ता साझा स्रोतहरू अपडेट गरिन्छ। एकै पटक धेरै प्रोसेस पस्दा डाटा बिग्रने जोखिम हुन्छ।
२. समाधानका तीन अनिवार्य सर्तहरू:
• Mutual Exclusion: एउटा प्रोसेस क्रिटिकल सेक्सनभित्र हुँदा अर्को कुनै पनि प्रोसेस पस्न नपाउने।
• Progress: कोही पनि भित्र नभएको बेला भित्र जान चाहने प्रोसेसहरू बीच मात्र तुरुन्त निर्णय हुनुपर्ने।
• Bounded Waiting: पालो पर्खिरहेको प्रोसेसले निश्चित समयभित्र प्रवेश पाउने ग्यारेन्टी हुनुपर्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Critical Section Concept: A code segment in a cooperating program where shared resources (shared variables, memory buffers, banking balance variables) are accessed and updated.
2. Three Mandatory Requirements:
• Mutual Exclusion: If process P is executing in its critical section, no other process can be executing in its critical section simultaneously.
• Progress: If no process is executing in its critical section and some processes wish to enter, only those processes not executing in their remainder sections can participate in deciding who enters next, and this decision cannot be postponed indefinitely.
• Bounded Waiting: There must be a bound on the number of times other processes are allowed to enter their critical sections after a process has made a request to enter.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: सेमाफोर (Counting र Binary) र Mutex व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। सेमाफोरले Producer-Consumer समस्यालाई कसरी समाधान गर्दछ?
questions.question_english: Explain Semaphores (Counting Semaphore vs Binary Semaphore) and Mutex. How do semaphores solve the Producer-Consumer problem?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. सेमाफोरको अवधारणा: साझा स्रोतहरूको प्रयोगमा प्रोसेसहरू बीच तालमेल मिलाउन प्रयोग गरिने इन्टिजर रिएबल।
२. प्रकारहरू:
• Binary Semaphore: मान ० वा १ मात्र हुने, जसले एक पटकमा एउटालाई मात्र पहुँच दिन्छ।
• Counting Semaphore: निश्चित संख्याका धेरै स्रोतहरू बाँडफाँड गर्न प्रयोग हुने।
• Mutex: लक गर्ने थ्रेडले मात्र अनलक गर्न मिल्ने कडा सुरक्षा लक।
३. Producer-Consumer समाधान: बफर खाली हुँदा उपभोक्ता रोकिने र बफर भरिँदा उत्पादक रोकिने गरी सेमाफोरमार्फत सन्तुलन मिलाइन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Semaphore Concept: Synchronization tool using an integer variable accessed via atomic operations `wait()` (P) and `signal()` (V).
2. Types:
• Binary Semaphore: Integer value ranges only between 0 and 1. Used strictly for mutual exclusion (lock/unlock).
• Counting Semaphore: Integer value spans unrestricted domain. Used to control access to a finite pool of identical resource instances.
• Mutex: A locking mechanism with strict ownership (only the thread that locked the mutex can unlock it).
3. Producer-Consumer Solution: Uses 3 semaphores: `mutex` (initialized to 1 for mutual exclusion), `empty` (initialized to N for tracking available slots), and `full` (initialized to 0 for tracking filled slots). Prevents buffer overflow and underflow.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: CPU शेड्युलिङ एल्गोरिदमहरू (FCFS, SJF, Round Robin) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। राउन्ड रोबिनमा Time Quantum को प्रभावबारे चर्चा गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain CPU Scheduling Algorithms: FCFS, Shortest Job First (SJF), and Round Robin (RR). Discuss the impact of Time Quantum in Round Robin.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. CPU शेड्युलिङको भूमिका: कम्प्युटरको क्षमताको पूर्ण सदुपयोग गर्न कुन कामलाई कहिले प्रोसेसर दिने भनी निर्णय गर्ने विधि।
२. प्रमुख एल्गोरिदमहरू:
• FCFS: पहिले आउनेले पहिले सेवा पाउने। सरल तर ठूला कामले गर्दा साना काम धेरै बेर रोकिन सक्ने।
• SJF: सबैभन्दा छोटो कामलाई पहिले गर्ने। औसत पर्खाइ समय कम गर्ने तर ठूला काम अनिश्चितकालसम्म रोकिन सक्ने।
• Round Robin: प्रत्येक कामलाई निश्चित समय (Time Quantum) दिएर पालैपालो चलाउने।
३. Time Quantum को प्रभाव: यो धेरै ठूलो भए FCFS जस्तो बन्छ; धेरै सानो भए कामभन्दा स्विच गर्नमै समय खेर जान्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. CPU Scheduling: Allocates CPU core execution time among ready queue processes to maximize throughput and minimize latency.
2. Algorithms:
• First-Come, First-Served (FCFS): Non-preemptive. Simple FIFO queue, but suffers from Convoy Effect (short jobs stuck behind long CPU bursts).
• Shortest Job First (SJF): Schedules process with smallest next CPU burst. Mathematically optimal for minimizing average waiting time; non-preemptive or preemptive (SRTF). Vulnerable to starvation of long processes.
• Round Robin (RR): Preemptive scheduling where each ready process receives a fixed slice of CPU time (Time Quantum, q). Cyclically rotates through the ready queue.
3. Impact of Time Quantum:
• If q is too large: RR degrades into FCFS.
• If q is too small: High context-switching overhead dominates CPU time.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: डेडलोक (Deadlock) का चार आवश्यक सर्तहरू उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्। डेडलोक रोकथाम (Prevention) का उपायहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the four necessary Coffman conditions for Deadlock. Outline Deadlock Prevention strategies.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डेडलोकको अवधारणा: जब दुई वा बढी प्रोसेसहरू एकअर्काले रोकेर राखेको स्रोतको पर्खाइमा सधैंका लागि अड्किन्छन्, त्यस अवस्थालाई डेडलोक भनिन्छ।
२. चार आवश्यक सर्तहरू:
• Mutual Exclusion: स्रोत एक पटकमा एउटाले मात्र प्रयोग गर्न पाउने।
• Hold and Wait: आफूसँग स्रोत हुँदाहुँदै अर्को स्रोत मागिरहने।
• No Preemption: जबर्जस्ती स्रोत खोस्न नपाइने।
• Circular Wait: प्रोसेसहरू बीच एकले अर्कालाई पर्खने गोलाकार चक्र बन्ने।
३. रोकथामको उपाय: यी चारमध्ये कुनै एउटा सर्तलाई असम्भव बनाउने। सबै स्रोतहरूलाई नम्बरिङ गरी बढ्दो क्रममा मात्र माग्न दिने नियम लगाएर Circular Wait अन्त्य गरिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Deadlock Definition: A state where a set of processes are permanently blocked because each process holds a resource and waits for another resource held by another process.
2. Four Necessary Conditions (Coffman):
• Mutual Exclusion: At least one resource must be held in a non-shareable mode.
• Hold and Wait: A process holding at least one resource must be waiting to acquire additional resources held by other processes.
• No Preemption: Resources cannot be forcibly taken away; they are released only voluntarily by the holding process.
• Circular Wait: A closed chain of processes exists where P0 waits for P1, P1 waits for P2, and Pn waits for P0.
3. Prevention Strategy: Invalidate at least one condition. Eliminating Circular Wait via Global Resource Ordering (assigning strict numerical hierarchies to all resources and requiring ascending acquisition) is the industry standard.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: डेडलोक जोगिने (Avoidance) ब्याङ्कर्स एल्गोरिदम व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Safe State र Unsafe State बीच भिन्नता स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Banker's Algorithm for Deadlock Avoidance. Differentiate between Safe State and Unsafe State in operating systems.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. ब्याङ्कर्स एल्गोरिदम: कुनै प्रोसेसले स्रोत माग्दा उक्त स्रोत दिँदा प्रणाली सुरक्षित रहन्छ कि रहँदैन भनी जाँच गरेर मात्र स्रोत बाँड्ने विधि।
२. आवश्यक विवरणहरू: उपलब्ध स्रोत (Available), अधिकतम माग (Max), दिइसकिएको स्रोत (Allocation), र बाँकी आवश्यक स्रोत (Need)।
३. Safe र Unsafe State:
• Safe State: प्रणालीसँग कम्तीमा यस्तो एउटा क्रम उपलब्ध हुन्छ जसबाट सबै प्रोसेसहरूले पालो अनुसार स्रोत पाएर आफ्नो काम सुरक्षित रूपमा सम्पन्न गर्न सक्छन्।
• Unsafe State: कुनै पनि सुरक्षित क्रम नभएको अवस्था। यसमा डेडलोक हुन सक्ने उच्च जोखिम हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Banker's Algorithm Overview: A deadlock avoidance algorithm developed by Edsger Dijkstra that tests for safety by simulating the allocation of predetermined maximum possible amounts of resources before granting requests.
2. Data Structures: Available Vector, Max Matrix, Allocation Matrix, and Need Matrix (`Need[i][j] = Max[i][j] - Allocation[i][j]`).
3. Safe vs Unsafe State:
• Safe State: There exists at least one sequence of processes <P1, P2, ..., Pn> such that for each Pi, the resources that Pi can still request can be satisfied by currently available resources plus resources held by all preceding processes. Deadlock is mathematically impossible.
• Unsafe State: No guaranteed safe execution sequence exists. While an unsafe state is not automatically a deadlock, it can lead to deadlock if processes request their maximum claims.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: First Fit, Best Fit र Worst Fit मेमोरी बाँडफाँड रणनीतिहरूको तुलना गर्नुहोस्। आन्तरिक र बाह्य फ्र्याग्मेन्टेसन स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Contiguous Memory Allocation strategies: First Fit, Best Fit, and Worst Fit. Explain Internal Fragmentation and External Fragmentation.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. मेमोरी बाँडफाँड रणनीतिहरू:
• First Fit: माग पूरा गर्न सक्ने भेटिएको पहिलो खाली ठाउँ दिने। यो सबैभन्दा छिटो हुन्छ।
• Best Fit: मागसँग ठिक्क मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो खाली ठाउँ दिने।
• Worst Fit: उपलब्ध सबैभन्दा ठूलो खाली ठाउँ दिने।
२. फ्र्याग्मेन्टेसन:
• आन्तरिक (Internal): प्रोसेसलाई मागभन्दा ठूलो भाग दिँदा भित्रै खेर जाने खाली ठाउँ।
• बाह्य (External): जम्मा खाली ठाउँ प्रशस्त भए तापनि टुक्रा-टुक्रा भएर छरिएकाले नयाँ प्रोसेस नअट्ने समस्या। यसलाई Paging मार्फत समाधान गरिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Dynamic Storage Allocation Strategies:
• First Fit: Allocates the first available hole large enough. Fastest search.
• Best Fit: Allocates the smallest hole that is large enough. Leaves smallest leftover fragment, but requires scanning entire list.
• Worst Fit: Allocates the largest available hole. Produces largest leftover fragment, but slowest search.
2. Fragmentation Concepts:
• Internal Fragmentation: Memory allocated to a process is larger than requested memory. Unused space inside the allocated partition is wasted.
• External Fragmentation: Total free memory space exists to satisfy a request, but it is split into non-contiguous scattered holes. Solved by Compaction or Paging.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: Paging मेमोरी व्यवस्थापन प्रविधि व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Page Table, Page Table Entry र Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) को भूमिका स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Paging in memory management. Describe Page Table structure, Page Table Entry (PTE), and the role of Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB).
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Paging को अवधारणा: भर्चुअल मेमोरीलाई निश्चित आकारका 'Page' र मुख्य मेमोरीलाई उत्रै आकारका 'Frame' मा विभाजन गरी बाह्य फ्र्याग्मेन्टेसन अन्त्य गर्ने विधि।
२. ठेगाना रूपान्तरण: CPU ले मागेको पेज नम्बरलाई Page Table मार्फत वास्तविक मेमोरी फ्रेममा मिलाइन्छ।
३. TLB को भूमिका: भर्खरै प्रयोग भएका ठेगानाहरू सुरक्षित राख्ने उच्च गतिको हार्डवेयर क्यास, जसले गर्दा मेमोरी खोज्ने समय अत्यन्त छिटो हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Paging Architecture: Non-contiguous memory allocation scheme that eliminates external fragmentation. Divides virtual process memory into fixed-size Pages, and physical memory into identical-sized Frames.
2. Address Translation: CPU generates Logical Address = Page Number (p) + Page Offset (d). The Page Table maps `p` to Physical Frame Number (f). Physical Address = `f * Frame_Size + d`.
3. Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB): High-speed hardware associative cache built into the MMU storing recent Page-to-Frame translations. If TLB Hit, physical address generated in 1 cycle without main memory page table walk.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: पेज रिप्लेसमेन्ट एल्गोरिदमहरू (FIFO, LRU, Optimal) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Belady's Anomaly के हो?
questions.question_english: Explain Page Replacement Algorithms: FIFO, Least Recently Used (LRU), and Optimal (OPT). What is Belady's Anomaly?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. पेज रिप्लेसमेन्ट: जब मेमोरी भरिन्छ र नयाँ पेज ल्याउनुपर्छ, कुन पुरानो पेजलाई बाहिर निकाल्ने भनी छनोट गर्ने विधि।
२. एल्गोरिदमहरू:
• FIFO: सबैभन्दा पहिले आएको पेजलाई पहिले हटाउने।
• LRU: लामो समयदेखि प्रयोग नभएको पेजलाई हटाउने। यो धेरै प्रभावकारी हुन्छ।
• Optimal: भविष्यमा सबैभन्दा पछि प्रयोग हुने पेज हटाउने (सैद्धान्तिक मात्र)।
३. Belady's Anomaly: FIFO मा धेरै मेमोरी फ्रेम थप्दा पनि उल्टै पेज फल्ट बढ्ने अनौठो समस्या।
questions.answer_english:
1. Page Replacement: Invoked during a Page Fault when all physical frames are occupied and a victim frame must be evicted.
2. Algorithms:
• First-In, First-Out (FIFO): Evicts the oldest page brought into memory. Simple to implement with a queue.
• Least Recently Used (LRU): Evicts the page that has not been referenced for the longest period of time. Approximates optimal replacement using timestamp or stack.
• Optimal (OPT): Evicts the page that will not be used for the longest period of time in the future. Theoretical benchmark; impossible to implement in practice.
3. Belady's Anomaly: A phenomenon in FIFO where increasing the number of physical frames paradoxically increases the number of page faults.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: भर्चुअल मेमोरी के हो? डिमान्ड पेजिङ, पेज फल्ट ह्यान्डलिङ प्रक्रिया र थ्रेसिङ (Thrashing) को अवधारणा व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: What is Virtual Memory? Explain Demand Paging, Page Fault Handling Routine, and the concept of Thrashing in operating systems.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. भर्चुअल मेमोरी: मुख्य मेमोरी (RAM) को क्षमताभन्दा ठूला प्रोग्रामहरू पनि हार्ड डिस्कको सहायताले चलाउन सकिने प्रविधि।
२. Demand Paging: काम लाग्ने बेलामा मात्र पेजलाई डिस्कबाट मेमोरीमा ल्याउने विधि।
३. Page Fault: जब खोजेको पेज मेमोरीमा भेटिँदैन, अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले डिस्कबाट खोजेर ल्याउने प्रक्रिया।
४. Thrashing: जब मेमोरीको अभावमा कम्प्युटरले काम गर्नुभन्दा पेज साटासाट (Swapping) गर्नमै पूरै समय खेर फाल्छ, कम्प्युटर ह्याङ हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Virtual Memory Concept: Separation of user logical memory from physical memory, allowing execution of processes larger than physical RAM.
2. Demand Paging: Pages are loaded into RAM only when referenced during execution ('lazy swapper').
3. Page Fault Routine: 1. CPU references page with invalid bit. 2. Trap to OS. 3. OS locates page on swap disk. 4. Free frame found. 5. I/O scheduled to read page into frame. 6. Page table updated to valid. 7. Faulting instruction restarted.
4. Thrashing: High paging activity where system spends more time servicing page faults and swapping pages than executing actual application instructions. Mitigated by Working-Set Model.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: लिनक्समा फाइल सिस्टम (ext4) को कार्यान्वयन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Inode संरचना, डाटा ब्लक र डाइरेक्टरी म्यापिङ स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain File System Implementation in Linux (ext4). Detail Inode structure, data blocks, indirect blocks, and directory mapping.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Inode को अवधारणा: लिनक्समा फाइलको नाम र वास्तविक डाटा बाहेक फाइलको सम्पूर्ण विवरण (साइज, अनुमति, समय) राख्ने संरचनालाई Inode भनिन्छ।
२. Inode भित्रका मुख्य कुराहरू: फाइलको साइज, अनुमति, र डाटा कहाँ छ भनी देखाउने १२ वटा प्रत्यक्ष पोइन्टरहरू, साथै ठूला फाइलका लागि अप्रत्यक्ष पोइन्टरहरू।
३. डाइरेक्टरी म्यापिङ: लिनक्समा फोल्डर पनि एउटा फाइल नै हो, जसले फाइलको नाम र त्यसको Inode नम्बरलाई जोडेर राख्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Inode Architecture: An index node (Inode) is a fixed-size metadata data structure storing all attributes of a file except its name and actual file data.
2. Inode Structure Fields: File size, UID/GID owner, access permissions (rwx), timestamps (mtime, ctime, atime), link count, and pointer array:
• 12 Direct Block Pointers (point directly to data blocks).
• 1 Singly Indirect Pointer (points to block of pointers).
• 1 Doubly Indirect Pointer.
• 1 Triply Indirect Pointer.
3. Directory Mapping: In Linux, a directory is simply a special file containing a table mapping filename strings to their corresponding Inode numbers.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: डिस्क शेड्युलिङ एल्गोरिदमहरू (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN) बीच Seek Time र Starvation का आधारमा तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Disk Scheduling Algorithms: FCFS, Shortest Seek Time First (SSTF), SCAN (Elevator), and C-SCAN in terms of seek time and starvation.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डिस्क शेड्युलिङको भूमिका: हार्ड डिस्कको रिड/राइट हेडलाई कम घुमाएर छिटो डाटा पढ्नका लागि अनुरोधहरूको क्रम मिलाउने विधि।
२. तुलना:
• FCFS: पहिले आउनेलाई पहिले सेवा दिने। कुनै विभेद हुँदैन तर हेड धेरै घुम्नुपर्दा समय बढी लाग्छ।
• SSTF: हालको हेडबाट सबैभन्दा नजिकको डाटा पहिले पढ्ने। छिटो हुन्छ तर टाढाको डाटा धेरै बेर रोकिन सक्छ।
• SCAN: एकातिरबाट अर्को कुनासम्म पढ्दै जाने र फेरि फर्किँदै पढ्ने (लिफ्ट जस्तै)।
• C-SCAN: एकातिर मात्र पढ्दै जाने र फर्किँदा केही नपढी सिधै सुरुमा आउने, जसले गर्दा पर्खाइ समय समान हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Disk Scheduling Overview: Orders pending I/O read/write cylinder requests on hard drives to minimize mechanical seek time.
2. Comparison:
• FCFS: Serves requests in arrival order. Fair and no starvation, but causes wild head swings and high average seek time.
• SSTF: Serves closest cylinder request to current head position. Minimizes seek time, but prone to starvation of distant requests.
• SCAN (Elevator): Head moves in one direction servicing requests until it hits the disk end, then reverses direction. Prevents starvation.
• C-SCAN (Circular SCAN): Moves in one direction servicing requests; upon hitting end, immediately returns to beginning without servicing on return trip. Provides uniform waiting time.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: इन्टरप्राइज बैंकिङमा Linux Server र Windows Server का सुरक्षा मोडलहरूको तुलना गर्नुहोस्: ACLs, SELinux र विशेषाधिकार विभाजन।
questions.question_english: Compare Linux Server and Windows Server security models in enterprise banking: Access Control Lists (ACLs), SELinux, and privilege separation.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. सर्भर सुरक्षाको तुलना:
• Linux Server: खुला स्रोत, अत्यन्त सुरक्षित, कम मेमोरी खाने, र SELinux मार्फत कडा सुरक्षा नियन्त्रण। बैंकको मुख्य कोर डाटाबेसका लागि लिनक्स बढी रोजिन्छ।
• Windows Server: Active Directory मार्फत बैंकका सयौं शाखाका कम्प्युटरहरू केन्द्रीय रूपमा नियन्त्रण गर्न सहज, प्रयोगकर्तामैत्री, र Group Policy मार्फत सुरक्षा नियम लागू गर्न सजिलो।
questions.answer_english:
1. Security Architecture in Banking Servers:
• Linux Server: Utilizes Discretionary Access Control (POSIX permissions rwxrwxrwx) enhanced by Mandatory Access Control (SELinux / AppArmor) enforcing Type Enforcement to restrict compromised daemon privileges. Minimal attack surface via headless minimal installations.
• Windows Server: Utilizes rich Discretionary ACLs (DACLs) and System ACLs (SACLs) deeply integrated with Active Directory Kerberos and Group Policy Objects (GPOs). Implements User Account Control (UAC) and BitLocker.
2. Banking Recommendation: Linux is dominant for mission-critical CBS database servers and web proxies; Windows Server is dominant for enterprise domain management and branch workstation fleets.

questions.unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
questions.question_nepali: युनिक्स/लिनक्सका प्रोसेस म्यानेजमेन्ट सिस्टम कलहरू (`fork()`, `exec()`, `wait()`, `exit()`) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। युजर मोडबाट कर्नेल मोडमा रूपान्तरण कसरी हुन्छ?
questions.question_english: Explain Unix / Linux System Calls for process management: `fork()`, `exec()`, `wait()`, and `exit()`. Detail User-Space to Kernel-Space mode transitions.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. सिस्टम कलको अवधारणा: सामान्य सफ्टवेयरले अपरेटिङ सिस्टमको कर्नेलसँग सेवा माग्ने आधिकारिक माध्यम।
२. मुख्य सिस्टम कलहरू:
• `fork()`: चलिरहेको प्रोसेसको नयाँ दुरुस्त प्रतिलिपि (Child Process) सिर्जना गर्छ।
• `exec()`: हालको प्रोसेसको ठाउँमा नयाँ प्रोग्राम लोड गरेर चलाउँछ।
• `wait()`: सन्तान प्रोसेसको काम नसकिउन्जेल अभिभावक प्रोसेसलाई पर्खाएर राख्छ।
• `exit()`: प्रोसेसको काम समाप्त गरी स्रोतहरू खाली गर्दछ।
३. मोड रूपान्तरण: सफ्टवेयरले सिस्टम कल गर्दा CPU युजर मोडबाट सुरक्षित कर्नेल मोडमा जान्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. System Call Concept: Programmatic interface between an executing user application and the privileged operating system kernel.
2. Key System Calls:
• `fork()`: Creates an exact duplicate child process sharing open file descriptors with distinct PID. Utilizes Copy-On-Write (COW).
• `exec()`: Replaces current process memory space with a new executable program binary.
• `wait()`: Suspends calling parent process until child process terminates to reap its exit status and prevent zombie processes.
• `exit()`: Terminates process, deallocates resources, and passes status code to parent.
3. Mode Transition: User application executes a software trap/syscall instruction (`INT 0x80` or `SYSCALL`), transitioning CPU privilege mode from Ring 3 (User) to Ring 0 (Kernel).

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: DBMS को Three-Schema Architecture व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Logical Data Independence र Physical Data Independence बीच भिन्नता छुट्याउनुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the Three-Schema Architecture of DBMS. Differentiate between Logical Data Independence and Physical Data Independence.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Three-Schema Architecture: डाटाबेसलाई तीन तहमा विभाजन गर्ने प्रणाली: आन्तरिक तह (भौतिक भण्डारण), तार्किक तह (टेबल र सम्बन्धहरू), र बाह्य तह (प्रयोगकर्ताको स्क्रिन)।
२. डाटा स्वतन्त्रता:
• Logical Data Independence: मुख्य डाटाबेसमा नयाँ टेबल वा फिल्ड थप्दा प्रयोगकर्ताको सफ्टवेयर वा भ्यु परिवर्तन गर्नु नपर्ने।
• Physical Data Independence: हार्ड डिस्क फेर्दा वा इन्डेक्सिङ बदल्दा मुख्य डाटाबेस र प्रोग्राममा कुनै असर नपर्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Three-Schema Architecture: Separates physical storage details from user applications: Internal Level (physical storage structures), Conceptual Level (community logical structure, tables, constraints), External Level (user views).
2. Data Independence:
• Logical Data Independence: Ability to modify conceptual schema (e.g., adding a table, changing attributes) without requiring changes to external schemas or existing application programs.
• Physical Data Independence: Ability to modify internal physical schema (e.g., switching from HDD to SSD, altering B-Tree indexes) without changing conceptual schemas or application code.

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: रिलेशनल डाटाबेसमा Super Key, Candidate Key, Primary Key, Foreign Key र Composite Key उदाहरण सहित परिभाषित गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Define Keys in Relational Database: Super Key, Candidate Key, Primary Key, Foreign Key, and Composite Key with examples.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डाटाबेस की (Keys) को अवधारणा: टेबलभित्रका प्रत्येक हरफ (रो) लाई अद्वितीय रूपमा पहिचान गर्न प्रयोग गरिने फिल्ड।
२. मुख्य कीहरू:
• Super Key: हरफलाई पहिचान गर्न सक्ने एक वा बढी फिल्डहरूको समूह।
• Candidate Key: कुनै अनावश्यक फिल्ड नभएको न्यूनतम सुपर की।
• Primary Key: टेबलको मुख्य पहिचानकर्ता, जुन कहिल्यै दोहोरिँदैन र खाली (Null) हुँदैन (जस्तै: खाता नम्बर)।
• Foreign Key: अर्को टेबलको प्राइमरी कीसँग सम्बन्ध जोड्ने फिल्ड।
• Composite Key: दुई वा बढी फिल्डहरू मिलेर बनेको संयुक्त प्राइमरी की।
questions.answer_english:
1. Relational Keys: Attributes uniquely identifying rows and enforcing referential integrity.
2. Definitions:
• Super Key: Any set of one or more attributes that collectively identifies a tuple uniquely.
• Candidate Key: A minimal Super Key with no redundant attributes (e.g., `Account_Number`, `Citizenship_No`).
• Primary Key: Candidate key chosen by database designer as primary identifier; must be unique and non-null.
• Foreign Key: Attribute in one table that references Primary Key in another table, enforcing referential integrity.
• Composite Key: Primary key composed of two or more attributes (e.g., `Branch_Code` + `Account_No`).

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। यो 3NF भन्दा कसरी फरक छ? बैंकिङ उदाहरण सहित स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF). How does BCNF differ from Third Normal Form (3NF)? Provide a banking schema example.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. BCNF को अवधारणा: यो 3NF भन्दा कडा सामान्यीकरण (Normalization) नियम हो। यसमा प्रत्येक functional dependency (X -> Y) मा बायाँतर्फको 'X' अनिवार्य रूपमा Super Key हुनैपर्छ।
२. 3NF सँग भिन्नता: 3NF मा दायाँतर्फको 'Y' प्राइम एट्रिब्युट भए पनि छुट पाइन्छ, तर BCNF मा कुनै छुट हुँदैन।
३. बैंकिङ उदाहरण: शाखा, ग्राहक र कर्जा अधिकृतको टेबलमा अधिकृतले शाखा निर्धारण गर्ने अवस्थालाई अलग-अलग दुईवटा टेबलमा विभाजन गरेर BCNF हासिल गरिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. BCNF Definition: A relation R is in BCNF if for every non-trivial functional dependency X -> Y, X must be a Super Key.
2. Difference from 3NF: In 3NF, X -> Y is allowed if X is a super key OR Y is a prime attribute (part of candidate key). BCNF eliminates this second clause entirely, resolving anomalies in tables with multiple overlapping candidate keys.
3. Banking Example: Schema `Loan_Officer(Branch, Customer, Officer)` where `(Branch, Customer) -> Officer` and `Officer -> Branch`. This is in 3NF, but violates BCNF because `Officer` is not a super key. Decomposed into `(Officer, Branch)` and `(Customer, Officer)` to achieve BCNF.

questions.question_nepali: डाटाबेस इन्डेक्सिङ व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। रिलेशनल डाटाबेसमा B-Tree र B+ Tree डाटा संरचनाहरूको तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Database Indexing. Compare B-Tree and B+ Tree data structures in relational database storage engines.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डाटाबेस इन्डेक्सिङको अवधारणा: पुस्तकको अन्त्यमा रहेको अनुक्रमणिका जस्तै, पूरै डाटाबेस नखोजी सिधै खोजेको रेकर्ड तुरुन्तै पत्ता लगाउने प्रविधि।
२. B-Tree र B+ Tree को तुलना:
• B-Tree: मुख्य डाटाका पोइन्टरहरू रूखका बीचका हाँगा र पात दुवैमा हुन्छन्।
• B+ Tree: बीचका हाँगाहरूमा की (Key) मात्र हुन्छन् र वास्तविक डाटा सबैभन्दा तल्लो तह (पात) मा मात्र हुन्छ। सबै पातहरू एकआपसमा जोडिएका हुन्छन्।
३. बैंकिङमा फाइदा: मिति वा रकमको दायरा (Range Query) खोज्न B+ Tree अत्यन्त छिटो हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Database Indexing: Auxiliary data structures providing O(log N) lookup instead of costly O(N) full table scans.
2. B-Tree vs B+ Tree:
• B-Tree: Keys and actual record data pointers are stored in both internal nodes and leaf nodes. Search can terminate early at internal node.
• B+ Tree: Internal nodes store only indexing search keys; all data records reside strictly in leaf nodes. Leaf nodes are linked via a bidirectional linked list.
3. Why B+ Tree is Preferred in RDBMS: Range queries (`WHERE date BETWEEN x AND y`) are ultra-fast in B+ Trees because the engine simply scans the linked leaf nodes sequentially without traversing tree roots repeatedly.

questions.question_nepali: वाणिज्य बैंकको रकम स्थानान्तरणको सन्दर्भमा डाटाबेस ट्रान्ज्याक्सनका ACID गुणहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the ACID properties of database transactions in the context of commercial bank fund transfers.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. ACID गुणहरूको अवधारणा: बैंकको कारोबार सुरक्षित र भरपर्दो बनाउन डाटाबेसले पालना गर्ने चार आधारभूत नियमहरू।
• Atomicity (पूर्णता): कारोबार कि त पूरै सफल हुन्छ, कि त हुँदै हुँदैन। खाता 'क' बाट पैसा घट्ने तर 'ख' मा जम्मा नहुने अवस्था आउन दिँदैन।
• Consistency (एकरूपता): कारोबार हुनुअघि र पछि बैंकको कुल हिसाब र नियमहरू सधैं मिल्नुपर्छ।
• Isolation (अलगता): एकै पटक हजारौं कारोबार हुँदा एउटाको असर अर्कोमा पर्न दिँदैन।
• Durability (स्थायित्व): एक पटक कारोबार सफल भएपछि बिजुली गए पनि डाटा सुरक्षित रहन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. ACID Properties: Guarantees transactional validity amidst crashes and concurrency.
• Atomicity ('All or Nothing'): Either all operations of a transaction succeed, or the entire transaction is rolled back. In a Rs. 10,000 transfer: Debit from Account A and Credit to Account B both happen, or neither happens.
• Consistency: Preserves database integrity constraints. Sum of Account A + B balances must remain invariant before and after transfer.
• Isolation: Concurrent transactions execute without interfering. Another customer cannot observe intermediate state where Account A is debited but B not yet credited.
• Durability: Once committed, changes survive power outages and crashes via write-ahead logging (WAL).

questions.question_nepali: Transaction Isolation Levels (Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable) र Concurrency समस्याहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Transaction Isolation Levels: Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, and Serializable, and concurrency phenomena.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. आइसोलेसन लेभलको अवधारणा: एकै पटक धेरै कारोबार हुँदा डाटा एकअर्कामा नजुधोस् भनी लगाइने सुरक्षा तह।
२. तहहरू:
• Read Uncommitted: सबैभन्दा कमजोर; अर्काले सेभ नगरेको डाटा पनि देखिने (Dirty Read)।
• Read Committed: सेभ भएको आधिकारिक डाटा मात्र देखिने।
• Repeatable Read: एउटै कारोबारभित्र पटकपटक हेर्दा एउटै विवरण देखिने।
• Serializable: सबैभन्दा कडा तह; सबै कारोबारहरू पालैपालो भएको जस्तै पूर्ण सुरक्षित हुने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Concurrency Phenomena:
• Dirty Read: Reading uncommitted changes of another transaction.
• Non-Repeatable Read: Re-reading same row returns different values modified by another committed transaction.
• Phantom Read: Re-executing query returns new inserted rows committed by another transaction.
2. Isolation Levels:
• Read Uncommitted: Prevents nothing; allows dirty reads.
• Read Committed: Prevents dirty reads; allows non-repeatable reads (Standard default in Oracle/PostgreSQL).
• Repeatable Read: Prevents dirty and non-repeatable reads; allows phantoms (Standard default in MySQL InnoDB).
• Serializable: Complete serial isolation; prevents all concurrency phenomena using 2-Phase Locking or SSI.

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: Concurrency Control मा Two-Phase Locking (2PL), Strict 2PL र Rigorous 2PL प्रोटोकलहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Concurrency Control: Two-Phase Locking (2PL) Protocol, Strict 2PL, and Rigorous 2PL in database engines.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. 2PL प्रोटोकल: धेरै कारोबार एकसाथ हुँदा डाटा नबिग्रियोस् भनेर लक (Lock) लगाउने दुई-चरणे नियम।
• Growing Phase: यस चरणमा आवश्यकता अनुसार नयाँ लकहरू मात्र लिन पाइन्छ, छोड्न पाइँदैन।
• Shrinking Phase: यस चरणमा लकहरू छोड्न मात्र पाइन्छ, नयाँ लक लिन पाइँदैन।
२. अन्य प्रकारहरू:
• Strict 2PL: कारोबार पूर्ण रूपमा सेभ (Commit) नभएसम्म राइट लक नछोड्ने, जसले गर्दा अन्य कारोबार प्रभावित हुँदैनन्।
• Rigorous 2PL: कारोबार नसकिउन्जेल कुनै पनि रिड वा राइट लक नछोड्ने, जुन वित्तीय डाटाबेसमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Two-Phase Locking (2PL): Guarantees serializability of concurrent transactions via two distinct phases:
• Growing Phase: Transaction acquires locks as needed; cannot release any locks.
• Shrinking Phase: Transaction releases locks; cannot acquire any new locks.
2. Variants:
• Strict 2PL: All Exclusive (X) locks held by transaction are retained until commit/abort. Prevents cascading rollbacks.
• Rigorous 2PL: Both Shared (S) and Exclusive (X) locks are retained until commit/abort. Produces strictly serializable schedules; standard in financial database engines.

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: डाटाबेस ब्याकअप रणनीतिहरू (Full, Differential, Incremental) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Transaction Log ले Point-in-Time Recovery मा कसरी मद्दत गर्छ?
questions.question_english: Explain Database Backup Strategies: Full Backup, Differential Backup, and Incremental Backup. How are Transaction Logs used in Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR)?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. ब्याकअपका प्रकारहरू:
• Full Backup: सम्पूर्ण डाटाबेसको पूर्ण प्रतिलिपि। धेरै ठाउँ लिन्छ तर रिकभरी छिटो हुन्छ।
• Differential Backup: पछिल्लो Full ब्याकअपपछि थपघट भएको डाटा मात्र ब्याकअप गर्ने।
• Incremental Backup: पछिल्लो जुनसुकै ब्याकअपपछि नयाँ थपिएको डाटा मात्र लिने। यो छिटो हुन्छ तर रिकभरीमा सबै फाइल चाहिन्छ।
२. Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR): बैंकको डाटाबेस बिग्रँदा ट्रान्ज्याक्सन लगहरूको सहायताले समस्या आउनुभन्दा ठीक १ सेकेन्ड अगाडिसम्मको सम्पूर्ण कारोबार दुरुस्त फिर्ता ल्याउन सकिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Backup Types:
• Full Backup: Complete archive of entire database. Large storage, long duration, fastest recovery.
• Differential Backup: Copies only blocks modified since last Full Backup. Moderate storage, requires Full + 1 Differential for restore.
• Incremental Backup: Copies only blocks modified since last Incremental/Full Backup. Smallest storage, fast backup, but requires restoring Full + all successive Increments sequentially.
2. Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR): Database engines continually write committed transaction logs (Write-Ahead Logs / redo logs) to archive storage. During a disaster, the database restores the last full backup and rolls forward transaction logs up to the exact second prior to corruption.

questions.question_nepali: RTO र RPO परिभाषित गर्नुहोस्। Cold Site, Warm Site, Hot Site र Mirrored Site बीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Define Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO). Contrast Cold Site, Warm Site, Hot Site, and Mirrored Site in banking Disaster Recovery.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. विपद् व्यवस्थापनका सूचकहरू:
• RTO (Recovery Time Objective): प्रणाली बन्द भएपछि कति समयभित्र पुनः चालू गरिसक्नुपर्छ भन्ने समय सीमा।
• RPO (Recovery Point Objective): विपद् आउँदा अधिकतम कति समयसम्मको डाटा गुम्न स्वीकार्य हुन्छ (जस्तै: शून्य सेकेन्ड)।
२. डिजास्टर रिकभरी (DR) साइटका प्रकारहरू:
• Cold Site: खाली भवन र बिजुली मात्र भएको ठाउँ। चालू गर्न धेरै दिन लाग्छ।
• Warm Site: हार्डवेयर जडान भएको तर डाटा पुरानो भएको ठाउँ।
• Hot Site: सबै उपकरण र डाटा तयारी अवस्थामा रहेको ठाउँ। केही मिनेटमै सेवा सुरु हुन्छ।
• Mirrored Site: मुख्य डाटा सेन्टरसँगै वास्तविक समयमा डाटा दुरुस्त कपी हुने सक्रिय साइट। RTO र RPO शून्य हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. DR Metrics:
• Recovery Time Objective (RTO): Maximum acceptable duration of system downtime following a disruption before business continuity is restored.
• Recovery Point Objective (RPO): Maximum acceptable data loss measured in time (e.g., transactions lost since last backup).
2. Disaster Recovery Sites:
• Cold Site: Empty data center facility with power and cooling; no pre-installed hardware. RTO = days/weeks.
• Warm Site: Hardware installed, but data not synchronized in real time; requires restoring backups. RTO = hours.
• Hot Site: Fully equipped server infrastructure with continuous asynchronous data replication. RTO = minutes; RPO = minutes.
• Mirrored Site: Real-time synchronous active-active replication. Zero RTO, zero RPO. Highest cost; gold standard for core banking CBS.

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: SQL Views र Materialized Views व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। बैंकिङ डाटाबेसमा भ्यु प्रयोग गर्दा हुने फाइदा र सुरक्षा महत्त्व स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain SQL Views and Materialized Views. Discuss the advantages and security implications of using Views in banking databases.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. भ्यु (View) को अवधारणा:
• Standard View: डाटाबेसको भर्चुअल टेबल, जसले आफैँ डाटा भण्डारण नगरी मुख्य टेबलबाट छानेर देखाउँछ।
• Materialized View: जटिल हिसाबहरूको नतिजालाई डिस्कमा छुट्टै टेबल बनाएर सुरक्षित राख्छ, जसले गर्दा रिपोर्टहरू छिटो खुल्छन्।
२. बैंकिङमा फाइदा र सुरक्षा:
• सुरक्षा: कर्मचारीलाई पूरै टेबल नदेखाई आवश्यक विवरण मात्र देखाउन (जस्तै: खाता नम्बरको पछाडिको ४ अंक मात्र) भ्यु प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
• गोपनीयता: संवेदनशील तलब वा ब्यालेन्सका विवरणहरू अनाधिकृत प्रयोगकर्ताबाट लुकाउन सकिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Views Concept:
• Standard View: Virtual table defined by an underlying SQL SELECT query. Does not store physical data; query executes dynamically upon each invocation.
• Materialized View: Physically stores the query result on disk, refreshed periodically or on trigger. Delivers high-speed read performance for complex aggregated analytical queries.
2. Banking Security & Advantages:
• Data Masking & Security: Restricts teller access by exposing only masked views (e.g., `XXXX-XXXX-1234` for credit cards) hiding sensitive salary or PII columns.
• Simplification: Hides complex multi-table joins from junior reporting analysts.
• Logical Independence: Changes in underlying table layouts do not break legacy reporting queries mapped to stable view interfaces.

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: डाटा वेयरहाउसिङका Star Schema, Snowflake Schema र Fact Constellation Schema बीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Data Warehousing schemas: Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Fact Constellation Schema with diagrams.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डाटा वेयरहाउस स्किमा: ठूला वित्तीय विश्लेषण र रिपोर्टिङका लागि डाटा व्यवस्थित गर्ने संरचना।
२. तुलना:
• Star Schema: बीचमा मुख्य फ्याक्ट टेबल (Fact Table) र वरिपरि सम्बन्धित डाइमेन्सन टेबलहरू तारा जस्तै जोडिएका हुन्छन्। यो धेरै छिटो चल्छ।
• Snowflake Schema: डाइमेन्सन टेबलहरूलाई पनि सामान्यीकरण (Normalize) गरी टुक्रा पारिएको हुन्छ। डाटा दोहोरिँदैन तर क्वेरी अलि जटिल हुन्छ।
• Fact Constellation: धेरै वटा फ्याक्ट टेबलहरू (कर्जा, निक्षेप, कार्ड) ले साझा डाइमेन्सन प्रयोग गर्ने विशाल संरचना।
questions.answer_english:
1. Data Warehouse Schemas: Dimensional modeling structures optimized for analytical OLAP querying.
2. Comparison:
• Star Schema: Central Fact Table (storing transactional metrics) directly connected to surrounding denormalized Dimension Tables. Fastest query joins, but contains redundant dimension attributes.
• Snowflake Schema: Normalized variant where dimension tables are broken down into sub-dimensions (e.g., splitting `Customer` into `City` and `Country`). Reduces data redundancy, but requires complex multi-table joins.
• Fact Constellation (Galaxy Schema): Contains multiple central Fact Tables sharing interconnected dimension tables. Standard schema for enterprise banking spanning multiple business units (Loans, Deposits, Cards).

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: OLTP र OLAP प्रणाली बीच डाटाबेस डिजाइन, क्वेरी प्रकृति र बैंकिङ प्रयोगका आधारमा तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Contrast OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) and OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) with respect to database design, queries, and banking use cases.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. OLTP र OLAP को अवधारणा: डाटाबेसमा दैनिक कारोबार गर्ने र विगतको विश्लेषण गर्ने दुई भिन्न प्रणाली।
२. तुलना:
• कार्य: OLTP ले दैनिक रियल-टाइम कारोबार सम्हाल्छ; OLAP ले विगतका तथ्याङ्क विश्लेषण गर्दछ।
• डिजाइन: OLTP मा डाटा दोहोरिन नदिन सामान्यीकरण (3NF) गरिन्छ; OLAP मा छिटो पढ्नका लागि स्टार स्किमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
• क्वेरी: OLTP मा साना र द्रुत अपडेटहरू (इन्सर्ट/अपडेट) हुन्छन्; OLAP मा ठूला विश्लेषण रिपोर्टहरू निकालिन्छ।
• बैंकिङ प्रयोग: एटीएम र खाताबाट पैसा झिक्न OLTP प्रयोग हुन्छ भने बैंकको नाफा-नोक्सान र जोखिम विश्लेषण गर्न OLAP प्रयोग हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Overview: Two foundational paradigms of database processing.
2. Comparison:
• Focus: OLTP manages day-to-day real-time transactions; OLAP manages historical analytical forecasting.
• Database Design: OLTP uses 3NF normalized relational schemas minimizing write redundancy; OLAP uses denormalized dimensional star/snowflake schemas.
• Operations: OLTP is dominated by high-volume short `INSERT`/`UPDATE` operations with millisecond latency; OLAP is dominated by complex `SELECT` aggregations spanning gigabytes.
• Banking Scenarios: OLTP runs Core Banking (ATM withdrawals, balance transfers); OLAP runs Business Intelligence (customer churn prediction, credit risk portfolio analysis).

questions.unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Web Technologies & Disaster Recovery
questions.question_nepali: NoSQL डाटाबेस व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Document, Key-Value, Columnar र Graph डाटाबेसको तुलना गर्दै बैंकहरूमा NoSQL किन प्रयोग गरिन्छ, चर्चा गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain NoSQL Databases. Compare Document, Key-Value, Columnar, and Graph databases, and discuss when NoSQL is preferred over RDBMS in banking.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. NoSQL को अवधारणा: परम्परागत टेबल र रिलेसन बिना नै विशाल मात्राको डाटा तीव्र गतिमा भण्डारण गर्न सक्ने आधुनिक डाटाबेस।
२. प्रकारहरू:
• Key-Value (Redis): कि र भ्यालुका रूपमा छिटो डाटा राख्ने (ओटीपी र सेसनका लागि उपयुक्त)।
• Document (MongoDB): JSON जस्तो लचिलो ढाँचामा डाटा राख्ने (KYC फारमका लागि उपयुक्त)।
• Columnar (Cassandra): विशाल लग फाइलहरू सुरक्षित राख्न प्रयोग हुने।
• Graph (Neo4j): विभिन्न खाता र व्यक्तिहरू बीचको सम्बन्ध देखाउने (सम्पत्ति शुद्धीकरण र ठगी पत्ता लगाउन)।
३. बैंकिङमा भूमिका: मुख्य खातामा RDBMS अनिवार्य हुन्छ तर अन्य सहायक सेवामा NoSQL धेरै प्रभावकारी हुन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. NoSQL Overview: Non-relational, schema-less, horizontally scalable databases engineered for massive distributed datasets.
2. Data Models:
• Key-Value (Redis): Hash table storage with ultra-fast lookup. Used for caching user sessions and OTP tokens.
• Document (MongoDB): JSON-like BSON documents with flexible schemas. Used for digital KYC and mobile banking content management.
• Columnar (Cassandra): Stores data in sparse column families across distributed clusters. Used for high-speed audit log storage.
• Graph (Neo4j): Models data as nodes and edges. Used for AML anti-money laundering money-mule link analysis and fraud rings.
3. RDBMS vs NoSQL: RDBMS is mandatory for ACID core ledgers; NoSQL is chosen for semi-structured log analytics, mobile caching, and social graph analysis.

questions.question_nepali: डिस्ट्रिब्युटेड डाटाबेसमा CAP Theorem र PACELC Theorem व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the CAP Theorem (Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance) and PACELC Theorem in distributed database systems.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. CAP Theorem को अवधारणा: धेरै सर्भरहरूमा फैलिएको डाटाबेसमा नेटवर्क अवरुद्ध हुँदा तीनवटा मध्ये दुईवटा गुण मात्र एकसाथ पाउन सकिन्छ: Consistency (एकरूपता), Availability (उपलब्धता), र Partition Tolerance (नेटवर्क अवरोध सहनशीलता)।
२. बैंकिङमा महत्त्व: बैंकहरूका लागि पैसा दोहोरो खर्च नहोस् भन्नका लागि Consistency सबैभन्दा महत्वपूर्ण हुन्छ। त्यसैले बैंकहरूले CP (Consistency + Partition Tolerance) रोज्छन्।
३. PACELC थ्योरम: सामान्य अवस्थामा पनि गति (Latency) र एकरूपता (Consistency) बीच तालमेल मिलाउनुपर्ने थप नियम।
questions.answer_english:
1. CAP Theorem (Eric Brewer): States that in any asynchronous distributed network subject to network partitions (P), a database can guarantee at most TWO out of three properties:
• Consistency (C): Every read receives the most recent write or an error.
• Availability (A): Every non-failing node returns a response, without guarantee that it contains the most recent write.
• Partition Tolerance (P): System continues to operate despite arbitrary message loss between nodes.
2. Banking Implication: Network partitions are inevitable over physical WANs. Core banking databases prioritize CP (Consistency over Availability) to prevent double-spending; social feeds prioritize AP.
3. PACELC Extension: If there is a Partition (P), trade off Availability (A) and Consistency (C); Else (E), trade off Latency (L) and Consistency (C).

questions.question_nepali: SQL Stored Procedures र Triggers व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। स्वचालित ट्रिगरले बैंकको अडिट लग र नियमनकारी पालनामा कसरी मद्दत गर्छ?
questions.question_english: Explain SQL Stored Procedures and Triggers. Discuss how automated triggers enforce audit logging and regulatory compliance in core banking databases.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Stored Procedure र Trigger:
• Stored Procedure: डाटाबेसभित्रै पहिले नै कम्पाइल गरेर राखिएको SQL कोड, जसले गर्दा काम छिटो हुन्छ र सुरक्षा बढ्छ।
• Trigger: कुनै टेबलमा डाटा थप्दा, बदल्दा वा मेट्दा स्वचालित रूपमा चल्ने विशेष प्रोग्राम।
२. बैंकिङ अडिटमा प्रयोग: जब कुनै कर्मचारीले ग्राहकको खातामा रकम फेरबदल गर्छ, ट्रिगरले तुरुन्तै पुरानो ब्यालेन्स, नयाँ ब्यालेन्स, कर्मचारीको नाम, कम्प्युटरको IP र मिति अडिट टेबलमा सुरक्षित गरिदिन्छ। यसले कर्मचारीको बदमासी रोक्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Concepts:
• Stored Procedure: Precompiled collection of SQL statements and procedural logic stored inside database catalog. Enhances execution speed, reduces network bandwidth, and prevents SQL Injection.
• Trigger: Event-driven procedural code that executes automatically before or after an `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE` event.
2. Banking Audit Logging Implementation: An `AFTER UPDATE` trigger on the `Account_Balance` table automatically writes old balance, new balance, timestamp, terminal IP, and employee user ID into an immutable `Audit_Trail` log table, ensuring tamper-evident tracking mandated by NRB guidelines.

questions.question_nepali: डाटाबेस डेडलोक व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। टाइमस्ट्याम्प प्रयोग गर्ने Wait-Die र Wound-Wait डेडलोक रोकथाम विधिहरूको तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Database Deadlocks. Compare Wait-Die and Wound-Wait non-preemptive deadlock prevention schemes using timestamps.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. डाटाबेस डेडलोक: जब दुईवटा कारोबारले एकअर्काको डाटा लक गरेर बस्छन् र अघि बढ्न सक्दैनन्, त्यसलाई डेडलोक भनिन्छ।
२. टाइमस्ट्याम्प विधिहरू:
• Wait-Die: पुरानो (पहिले सुरु भएको) कारोबारले नयाँलाई पर्खन पाउँछ, तर नयाँ कारोबारले पुरानोको डाटा मागेमा नयाँ तुरुन्तै रद्द (Die) हुन्छ।
• Wound-Wait: पुरानो कारोबारले नयाँ कारोबारबाट जबर्जस्ती डाटा खोस्न पाउँछ, तर नयाँले पुरानोलाई पर्खनुपर्छ।
३. फाइदा: यसले गर्दा प्रणालीमा कहिल्यै पनि डेडलोक हुँदैन।
questions.answer_english:
1. Database Deadlocks: Occurs when transaction T1 holds a lock on record A and waits for record B, while transaction T2 holds lock on record B and waits for record A.
2. Timestamp Prevention Schemes:
• Wait-Die (Non-preemptive): Older transaction can wait for a younger transaction; younger transaction requesting resource held by older transaction immediately dies (aborts and rolls back).
• Wound-Wait (Preemptive): Older transaction 'wounds' (preempts) the younger transaction holding the lock, forcing it to abort. Younger transaction can wait for an older transaction.
3. Comparison: Wound-Wait minimizes rollbacks because older transactions preemptively seize resources without waiting.

questions.question_nepali: बैंकिङ सुरक्षाका उदाहरण सहित CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability) र Non-Repudiation व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain the CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability) and Non-Repudiation with concrete banking security examples.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. CIA Triad को अवधारणा:
• Confidentiality (गोपनीयता): ग्राहकको पिन, पासवर्ड र खाता विवरण अनाधिकृत व्यक्तिले देख्न नसक्ने बनाउने।
• Integrity (अखण्डता): कारोबारको रकम वा विवरण बीचमा कसैले फेरबदल गर्न नसक्ने बनाउने।
• Availability (उपलब्धता): बैंकका सम्पूर्ण डिजिटल सेवाहरू २४/७ ग्राहकका लागि चालु अवस्थामा राख्ने।
२. Non-Repudiation (अस्वीकार गर्न नसकिने अवस्था): ग्राहकले कारोबार गरिसकेपछि 'मैले गरेको होइन' भन्न नसक्ने गरी डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर वा ओटीपीमार्फत प्रमाणित गर्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. CIA Triad in Banking:
• Confidentiality: Ensuring sensitive data (PIN, account balance, CVV) is shielded from unauthorized observation. Enforced via AES-256 encryption, access controls, and masking.
• Integrity: Protecting transactions from unauthorized tampering or alteration. Enforced via SHA-256 hashing, digital signatures, and database constraints.
• Availability: Ensuring banking systems (ATM, CBS, Mobile App) are accessible to authorized customers 24/7. Enforced via Tier-3 data centers, load balancers, and DDoS scrubbers.
2. Non-Repudiation: Proving conclusively that a specific user initiated a transaction so they cannot deny it later. Enforced via cryptographic asymmetric Digital Signatures and time-stamped OTP verification.

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: भाइरस, वार्म, ट्रोजन, र्‍यानसमवेयर र स्पाइवेयर जस्ता मालवेयरहरूको वर्गीकरण गर्दै बैंकहरूले अपनाउने प्रतिकार्यहरूबारे चर्चा गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Classify Malicious Software: Viruses, Worms, Trojan Horses, Ransomware, and Spyware, and discuss banking countermeasures.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. मालवेयरको वर्गीकरण:
• Virus: अन्य प्रोग्राममा टाँसिएर फैलिने हानिकारक कोड।
• Worm: आफैँ प्रतिलिपि बनाएर नेटवर्कभरी फैलिने खतरनाक प्रोग्राम।
• Trojan Horse: उपयोगी सफ्टवेयरको भेषमा कम्प्युटरभित्र पसेर गोप्य बाटो खोल्ने मालवेयर।
• Ransomware: कम्प्युटरका सम्पूर्ण फाइलहरू इन्क्रिप्ट गरेर फिरौती माग्ने भाइरस।
• Spyware/Keylogger: किबोर्डमा थिचेको पासवर्ड चोरेर ह्याकरलाई पठाउने जासुसी प्रोग्राम।
२. रोकथाम: बलियो एन्टिभाइरस (EDR), कर्मचारीको कम्प्युटरमा पेनड्राइभ ब्लक गर्ने, र सुरक्षित अफलाइन ब्याकअप राख्ने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Malware Classification:
• Virus: Malicious code that attaches to host executable files and propagates when host is executed.
• Worm: Standalone self-replicating malware that spreads autonomously across network vulnerabilities without user intervention.
• Trojan Horse: Disguises as legitimate software (e.g., PDF reader) to establish unauthorized backdoor access.
• Ransomware: Cryptographically encrypts core database storage volumes and demands cryptocurrency ransom for decryption keys.
• Spyware/Keylogger: Stealthily monitors keystrokes to exfiltrate employee credentials and banking secrets.
2. Banking Countermeasures: Centralized Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), Next-Gen Antivirus with behavioral heuristics, air-gapped immutable backups, and disabling USB ports on branch terminals.

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: Phishing, Spear Phishing, Whaling र Vishing जस्ता सोसियल इन्जिनियरिङ आक्रमणहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। बैंकहरूले अपनाउने सुरक्षा उपायहरू उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Social Engineering attacks: Phishing, Spear Phishing, Whaling, and Vishing. Outline defense mechanisms in banking institutions.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. सोसियल इन्जिनियरिङ: कम्प्युटरको कमजोरीभन्दा मानिसको सोझोपन वा डर-त्रासको फाइदा उठाएर पासवर्ड चोर्ने प्रविधि।
२. प्रकारहरू:
• Phishing: बैंकको नाममा नक्कली इमेल पठाएर पासवर्ड माग्ने।
• Spear Phishing: निश्चित व्यक्तिलाई लक्षित गरी पठाइने व्यक्तिगत इमेल।
• Whaling: बैंकका उच्च अधिकारी (CEO/CFO) लाई लक्षित गरी ठूलो रकम ट्रान्सफर गराउने ठगी।
• Vishing: फोन कल गरेर बैंक कर्मचारी हुँ भन्दै ओटीपी माग्ने ठगी।
३. सुरक्षा: दुई-तहको प्रमाणीकरण (2FA), सुरक्षित इमेल फिल्टरिङ, र ग्राहकलाई सचेतना फैलाउने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Social Engineering: Manipulating human psychology rather than exploiting technical software bugs to trick victims into divulging sensitive credentials.
2. Attack Vectors:
• Phishing: Mass untargeted fraudulent emails impersonating banks to harvest credit card numbers and passwords.
• Spear Phishing: Highly personalized fraudulent emails tailored to specific individuals using customized corporate knowledge.
• Whaling: Spear phishing directed at executive leaders (CEO, Chief Financial Officer) to authorize wire transfers.
• Vishing: Voice telephone fraud impersonating bank staff to coax customers into revealing OTP codes.
3. Defense Mechanisms: Mandatory multi-factor authentication (FIDO2 keys), DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM/DMARC), email sandboxing, and continuous customer awareness campaigns.

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: DoS र DDoS आक्रमण व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। बैंकहरूले SYN Flood र DNS Amplification आक्रमणलाई कसरी नियन्त्रण गर्छन्?
questions.question_english: Explain Denial of Service (DoS) and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. How do banks mitigate SYN Flood and DNS Amplification attacks?
questions.answer_nepali:
१. DoS र DDoS आक्रमण: बैंकको वेबसाइट वा सर्भरमा अत्यधिक नक्कली ट्राफिक पठाएर सर्भर डाउन गराउने र वास्तविक ग्राहकलाई सेवाबाट वञ्चित गर्ने आक्रमण।
२. प्रमुख प्रकार र समाधान:
• SYN Flood: TCP कनेक्सनको कमजोरीको फाइदा उठाएर सर्भरको मेमोरी भरिदिने आक्रमण। समाधान: SYN Cookies प्रविधि प्रयोग गर्ने।
• DNS Amplification: सानो अनुरोध पठाएर विशाल नक्कली डाटा बैंकको सर्भरतर्फ फर्काइदिने आक्रमण।
३. रोकथाम: बैंकको ट्राफिकलाई Cloud DDoS Scrubbing सेन्टरमार्फत छानेर मात्र भित्र पठाउने।
questions.answer_english:
1. DoS vs DDoS Overview: Flooding target servers or network links with illegitimate traffic to exhaust memory or bandwidth and deny service to genuine customers. DDoS utilizes thousands of compromised botnet nodes.
2. Attack Vectors & Mitigations:
• SYN Flood: Exploits TCP 3-way handshake by sending flood of SYN packets without acknowledging SYN-ACK, exhausting server TCP connection queue. Mitigation: SYN Cookies (cryptographically encodes state in initial sequence number without allocating memory until ACK arrives).
• DNS Amplification: UDP reflection attack with spoofed source IP generating huge responses. Mitigation: Disabling open DNS resolvers, rate limiting (RRL), and routing incoming traffic through upstream cloud DDoS scrubbing centers (Cloudflare Magic Transit / Akamai).

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: SQL Injection (SQLi) र Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। सुरक्षित बैंकिङ वेब एप्लिकेसन निर्माणमा यीबाट बच्ने उपायहरू उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain SQL Injection (SQLi) and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). Outline defense strategies in secure banking web application development.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. वेब एप्लिकेसनका कमजोरीहरू:
• SQL Injection: वेबपेजको फारममा गलत कोड हालेर डाटाबेसको पासवर्ड वा डाटा चोर्ने वा मेटाउने आक्रमण।
• Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): वेबसाइटभित्र हानिकारक जाभास्क्रिप्ट कोड घुसाएर ग्राहकको सेसन र पासवर्ड चोर्ने आक्रमण।
२. बच्ने उपायहरू:
• SQLi रोक्न: Prepared Statements र Parameterized Query को प्रयोग अनिवार्य गर्ने।
• XSS रोक्न: इनपुट डाटालाई राम्रोसँग फिल्टर गर्ने (Encoding) र कुकीमा `HttpOnly` फ्ल्याग लगाउने।
questions.answer_english:
1. Web Application Vulnerabilities:
• SQL Injection (SQLi): Attacker injects malicious SQL input through web input forms to alter database query logic (`' OR '1'='1`). Allows bypassing authentication, viewing unauthorized ledgers, or dumping passwords.
• Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): Attacker injects malicious client-side JavaScript into web pages viewed by other users. Steals session cookies and hijacks authenticated accounts.
2. Defenses:
• Defense against SQLi: Enforce Parameterized Queries / Prepared Statements exclusively; use Object-Relational Mappers (ORM); apply least privilege database account access.
• Defense against XSS: Context-aware Output Encoding, Content Security Policy (CSP) HTTP headers, and setting `HttpOnly` flags on session cookies.

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: IDS र IPS बीच नेटवर्क प्लेसमेन्ट, गति, र सिग्नेचर तथा अनोमली पहिचानका आधारमा तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Compare Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) in terms of placement, latency, and signature vs anomaly detection.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. IDS र IPS को भूमिका: बैंकको नेटवर्कभित्र हुने शंकास्पद गतिविधि र आक्रमण निगरानी गर्ने प्रणाली।
२. तुलना:
• IDS (Detection): नेटवर्कको छेउमा बसेर ट्राफिकको प्रतिलिपि मात्र हेर्छ र समस्या देखिए अलर्ट पठाउँछ। यसले आक्रमणलाई आफैँ रोक्न सक्दैन।
• IPS (Prevention): नेटवर्कको मुख्य बाटोमै बसेर ट्राफिक परीक्षण गर्छ र आक्रमण भेटिनासाथ प्याकेटलाई तुरुन्तै ब्लक गरिदिन्छ।
३. पहिचान विधि: Signature-based (पहिले नै थाहा भएका भाइरसको ढाँचासँग तुलना गर्ने) र Anomaly-based (सामान्यभन्दा फरक गतिविधि देखिनासाथ रोक्ने)।
questions.answer_english:
1. Overview: Core network security monitoring systems.
2. Comparison:
• IDS (Passive / Out-of-Band): Tapped via switch SPAN/mirror port. Monitors network traffic copies out-of-band; generates security alerts upon detecting malicious traffic. Zero packet forwarding latency, but cannot actively drop attacks.
• IPS (Active / In-Line): Positioned directly in-line with network traffic. Inspects and can actively drop packets, reset TCP sessions, and ban malicious IPs in real time. Adds slight packet processing latency.
3. Detection Methods: Signature-Based (matches against database of known attack patterns; fast, zero false positives, blind to zero-days) vs Anomaly-Based (builds baseline statistical profile; flags deviations, catches zero-day attacks, but prone to false alarms).

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: वाणिज्य बैंकमा SIEM र Security Operations Center (SOC) को आर्किटेक्चर व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Operations Center (SOC) architecture in a commercial bank.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. SOC (Security Operations Center): बैंकको डिजिटल प्रणालीहरूमा चौबीसै घण्टा निगरानी राख्ने, आक्रमण पहिचान गर्ने र तुरुन्तै रोक्ने प्राविधिक टोली र कक्ष।
२. SIEM को भूमिका: बैंकका सम्पूर्ण कम्प्युटर, सर्भर र फायरवालका लग (Logs) फाइलहरूलाई एकै ठाउँमा संकलन गरी विश्लेषण गर्ने सफ्टवेयर।
३. कार्यप्रणाली: जब धेरै ठाउँमा एकै पटक शंकास्पद गतिविधि देखिन्छ, SIEM ले तत्काल अलर्ट जारी गर्छ र सुरक्षा टोलीले आक्रमणकारीलाई प्रणालीबाट बाहिर निकालिदिन्छ।
questions.answer_english:
1. Security Operations Center (SOC): The dedicated organizational unit (personnel, processes, and technology) continuously monitoring, detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity incidents.
2. SIEM Platform Architecture:
• Data Ingestion: Aggregates event logs from firewalls, routers, Windows Active Directory, Linux servers, CBS databases, and endpoint antiviruses via Syslog/agents.
• Normalization & Correlation Engine: Parses disparate log formats into unified telemetry and correlates multi-source events (e.g., failed login on VPN followed by unusual database export).
• Alerting & Threat Intelligence: Integrates global threat feeds (IOCs) and escalates security incidents to SOC Tier 1/2 analysts.
• Compliance Archival: Securely stores cryptographically hashed audit trails for mandatory 180+ days per regulatory standards.

questions.unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines
questions.question_nepali: Vulnerability Assessment (VA) र Penetration Testing (PT) बीच भिन्नता छुट्याउनुहोस्। बैंकिङ पूर्वाधारमा हुने पेने रजिस्ट्रेसन टेस्टका चरणहरू व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Differentiate between Vulnerability Assessment (VA) and Penetration Testing (PT). Detail the phases of a penetration test on banking infrastructure.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. VA र PT बीच भिन्नता:
• Vulnerability Assessment: प्रणालीमा के-कस्ता प्राविधिक कमजोरीहरू छन् भनी स्वचालित सफ्टवेयरमार्फत सूची बनाउने कार्य।
• Penetration Testing: ती कमजोरीहरूको फाइदा उठाएर वास्तविक ह्याकरले जस्तै प्रणालीभित्र छिरेर देखाउने आधिकारिक परीक्षण।
२. PT का चरणहरू:
१. जानकारी संकलन: बैंकको नेटवर्क र सफ्टवेयरको विवरण खोज्ने।
२. स्क्यानिङ: खुला पोर्ट र सेवाहरू पत्ता लगाउने।
३. कमजोरी पहिचान: आक्रमण गर्न मिल्ने बाटो खोज्ने।
४. आक्रमण (Exploitation): प्रणालीभित्र अनाधिकृत प्रवेश गर्ने।
५. प्रतिवेदन: भेटिएका कमजोरी र समाधानका उपायहरू व्यवस्थापनलाई बुझाउने।
questions.answer_english:
1. VA vs PT:
• Vulnerability Assessment (VA): Automated, broad scanning to identify and catalog known software flaws, misconfigurations, and missing patches without exploiting them.
• Penetration Testing (PT): Goal-oriented, authorized simulation of a cyberattack to actively exploit vulnerabilities, bypass firewalls, and demonstrate real-world impact.
2. Penetration Testing Phases:
1. Reconnaissance (OSINT): Gathering intelligence on targets.
2. Scanning & Enumeration: Mapping open ports, services, and versions using Nmap.
3. Vulnerability Analysis: Identifying exploitable entry points.
4. Exploitation: Gaining unauthorized access (e.g., executing Metasploit payloads).
5. Post-Exploitation & Privilege Escalation: Lateral movement to CBS database servers.
6. Reporting: Documenting executive risk summaries and remediation blueprints.

questions.question_nepali: इन्टरप्राइज बैंकिङमा Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। यसका मुख्य सिद्धान्तहरू स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.question_english: Explain Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in enterprise banking. State the core tenets: 'Never Trust, Always Verify' and Micro-segmentation.
questions.answer_nepali:
१. Zero Trust Architecture को अवधारणा: 'आन्तरिक नेटवर्क सुरक्षित हुन्छ' भन्ने पुरानो मान्यतालाई त्यागेर जो-सुकैलाई पनि विना प्रमाण विश्वास नगर्ने आधुनिक सुरक्षा ढाँचा।
२. मुख्य सिद्धान्तहरू:
• कहिल्यै विश्वास नगर्ने, सधैं प्रमाणीकरण गर्ने: बैंकभित्रकै कर्मचारी वा बाहिरका ग्राहक, जो भए पनि प्रत्येक पटक कडा प्रमाणीकरण गर्ने।
• न्यूनतम अधिकार (Least Privilege): कर्मचारीलाई आफ्नो काम गर्न जति चाहिन्छ, त्यति मात्र अधिकार दिने।
• माइक्रो-सेग्मेन्टेसन: नेटवर्कलाई साना-साना सुरक्षित कोठाहरूमा विभाजन गर्ने, ताकि एउटा कम्प्युटर ह्याक भए पनि अर्कोमा जान नसकोस्।
questions.answer_english:
1. Zero Trust Architecture Concept: Eliminates the outdated concept of an implicit 'trusted internal network'. Assumes breach and enforces strict dynamic authentication and authorization for every request, whether originating inside or outside the corporate perimeter.
2. Core Tenets:
• 'Never Trust, Always Verify': Explicitly authenticate identity, device health, location, and context for every transaction.
• Principle of Least Privilege: Grant users and services only the minimum permissions required to perform their current task.
• Micro-Segmentation: Segregates network into granular isolated zones, preventing lateral movement of attackers.
• Continuous Telemetry: Real-time behavior monitoring and policy enforcement via Identity and Access Management (IAM).
